title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-08-25
content:
Applied ML weekly notes - 2026-08-25

Attendees: Asha, Miguel, Priya, Evan, Riley
Context: Weekly sync focused on quantization experiments (8-bit / QLoRA), eval pipeline regressions, and onboarding plan for the new Llama-3.1 variant we received from infra for dedicated runs.

1) Summary / Highlights
- 8-bit quantization pipeline: baseline 8-bit INT8 run shows ~1.9x throughput improvement and ~22% GPU memory reduction on A100-80GB compared to FP16 for generation workloads with 2k context; latency p50 improved from 220ms -> 120ms for 256-token responses in microbench harness.
- QLoRA fine-tuning experiments: 3/4 runs finished; one run (PR 128) shows minor perplexity increase but better instruction-following on our eval sets. Need further automatic/manual evals.
- Eval pipeline: discovered a flaky reranking test causing false-positive regressions; root cause traced to tokenization mismatch in nightly job (JIRA-AM-482). Fix merged but re-run required.
- Model onboarding: initial smoke tests for llama-3.1-8k passed; committing model card draft and rollout checklist.

2) Standup updates (quick hits)
- Asha: Finished optimized kernel selection script for INT8 path; landed benchmark harness changes. Running extended throughput sweeps across seq lengths.
- Miguel: Investigated reranker flaky tests; root cause is inconsistent sentence-split preprocessing in the nightly job—patch merged. Re-running nightly evals today.
- Priya: QLoRA run #3 shows instruction-following uptick on Helpfulness and Safety evals but small drop on long-context coherence. Starting ablation to isolate LoRA rank and learning rate.
- Evan: Onboarding checklist for llama-3.1: completed compatibility matrix (kv-cache shape, tokenizer); found one incompatible attention op for older runtime—filed infra ticket.
- Riley: Cost estimation for Dedicated: updated per-token cost model to include INT8 throughput gains. Presented numbers to product yesterday.

3) Experiments / Results (details)
- INT8 inference (A100-80GB, batch=4, seq=2048):
  * FP16 baseline: tokens/sec = 4200, p50 latency = 220ms, GPU mem = 58GB
  * INT8 optimized: tokens/sec = 8000, p50 latency = 120ms, GPU mem = 45GB
  * Notes: INT8 gains shrink at very low batch sizes (batch=1), need dynamic switching policy for latency SLOs.

- QLoRA finetune (7B model-base -> 7B-qlora):
  * RunA (lr=1e-4, rank=32): validation ppl 12.4 -> 12.6 (small regression), instruction score +6% on our internal rubric.
  * RunB (lr=5e-5, rank=16): validation ppl 12.3, instruction score +3%, better long-coherence.
  * Decision: keep RunB as candidate for canary; schedule human evals for top prompts.

4) Evals / Regression checks
- Nightly evals: reranker flaky test fixed (see JIRA-AM-482). Re-running 3 nights to clear historic noise.
- New eval subgroup: Long-context QAs (2k+ tokens) added to regression suite. Preliminary results: 8-bit INT8 inference introduces minor tokenization edge-cases at segment boundaries for some prompts -> create unit test.
- Safety checks: QLoRA runs passed automated safety filter at same rate as baseline; augment manual review sampling to 0.5% of outputs for the next week.

5) Model onboarding progress (llama-3.1-8k)
- Completed: tokenizer mapping, kv-cache compatibility, weight-conversion script for our runtime, model card draft v0.2.
- Blocker: one attention kernel (custom fused op) fails on older cuDNN versions used in some Dedicated pools; filed infra ticket for fallback patch. Until patched, mark older pools as incompatible in rollout config.
- Rollout plan: canary on dedicated pool D-qa (50 qps), monitor latency & reg suite for 48h, then expand to D-prod if stable.

6) Action items / Owners
- Asha: run full INT8 soft-switch policy prototype; PR expected by 2026-09-01.
- Miguel: re-run nightly evals for 3 nights and post consolidated report (due 2026-08-28).
- Priya: human eval plan for QLoRA RunB (recruit annotators + rubric) - draft due 2026-08-29.
- Evan: follow up with infra on fused-attention fallback and update onboarding checklist (JIRA ticket link in artifacts).
- Riley: submit updated Dedicated pricing model with INT8 numbers to finance by 2026-08-30.

7) Open questions / discussion items
- Thresholds for automatic INT8 fallback: what latency/regression delta should trigger falling back to FP16 for user-critical routes? (perf vs quality policy).
- Canary size for model-onboarding: is 50 qps safe given our current rollback speed? Seek product ops input.

8) Links / references
- PR: GITHUB:repo/rlhf/pull/128 (QLoRA training scripts and README)
- JIRA: JIRA-AM-482 (nightly reranker flaky test)
- Confluence: https://confluence.company/AppliedML/quant-eval-aug-2026 (detailed benchmark tables and plots)

Notes / quick scribbles:
- Consider adding dynamic batcher that picks INT8 when batch >=2 or when token-latency budget > 100ms.
- Human evaluation: emphasize long-context instructions and multi-step reasoning cases for QLoRA candidate.

Next sync: 2026-09-01 (same time).
summary: Weekly applied-ml notes covering INT8 quant gains, QLoRA candidate selection, flaky eval fix, and llama-3.1 onboarding checklist. Action items assigned; canary plan pending infra fallback.
